zh: 图片独占的 Markdown 链接和按钮使用自适应高度及正常文档流，保留居中和原生点击行为；检查普通、引用式、引用块及链接图片的完整高度与后续文字排列。
en: Give image-only Markdown links and buttons automatic height in normal document flow, preserving centering and native interactions. Check ordinary, reference-style, blockquote and linked images for full-height containment and following prose layout.
